summary.text: Duskmourn is a living House that has swallowed the rest of its world, and the Wanderer brings Kaito Shizuki, Niko Aris, Tyvar Kell and Zimone Wola through a carved door into it to find Nashi, who has been missing for three months.
The door vanishes behind them, the party is split up, and they learn that the House beguiles survivors into razorkin while the Cult of Valgavoth serves the Devouring Father.

Valgavoth, a demon bound in the house long ago, has become the House itself and can now spread to more worlds merely by knowing they exist, so the group fights to free Nashi and flee through an artificial door of light to Ravnica while the wounded Valgavoth survives.
